visual_action: A slideshow of still photos of Donald Trump. The first is a close-up of him speaking with his hands up. The subsequent photos show him at various sporting events: in a skybox at a basketball game, shaking hands with FIFA president Gianni Infantino with a trophy between them, and in a skybox at a football game. Each photo has a text overlay.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown in every photo and is the subject of the text 'the trump curse' and other text overlays.

on_screen_text.text: Asked FIFA to lift a player's suspension
Predicted a Chiefs Super Bowl win

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video; it is accompanied only by music.
audio_music: An ominous, atmospheric electronic track (identified as 'Gyroscope' by Boards of Canada) plays consistently throughout the video, creating a mysterious and fateful mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow of still photographs with text overlays.
cultural_references: The video's central premise is built on the 'sports curse' trope, where an individual is superstitiously believed to bring bad luck to a team.
USMNT (United States men's national soccer team)
central_claim: The video claims that Donald Trump is a 'curse' on sports teams, causing them to lose after he shows them support or attends their games.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump by portraying him as a jinx who brings bad luck to sports teams he is associated with.
